use_cases.UC1: Initial Page State — page loads with heading, empty file input, and upload button with correct attributes
use_cases.UC2: File Selection Behavior — selecting files updates the input correctly, re-selection overwrites
use_cases.UC3: Successful Upload Flow — uploading different file types shows success page with correct filename
use_cases.UC4: No File Selected Validation — clicking Upload with no file returns HTTP 500, back button recovers
use_cases.UC5: Sequential Uploads — uploading multiple files in sequence shows correct filename each time
use_cases.UC6: File Name Integrity — special characters, spaces, parentheses, hyphens, underscores, mixed case, and multiple dots are preserved
use_cases.UC7: Navigation Back from Success Page — browser back retains file, fresh navigation resets state
use_cases.UC8: Negative and Boundary Tests — double-click, single-file enforcement, success page DOM, repeated errors, refresh behavior

tests.title: Verify page load shows File Uploader heading, empty file input, and Upload button
Verify file input has correct attributes and no restrictions
Verify form element has correct attributes for multipart file upload
Selecting a file updates the file input with the chosen filename
Selecting a different file type (.json) updates the file input correctly
Selecting another file type (.png) updates the file input correctly
Re-selecting a file overwrites the previous selection
Uploading a .txt file shows success page with File Uploaded! heading
After successful upload, the uploaded filename is displayed exactly
Uploading a .json file succeeds and displays correct filename
Uploading a .png file succeeds and displays correct filename
Uploading a .md file succeeds and displays correct filename
Clicking Upload with no file selected returns HTTP 500 error
After receiving 500 error, navigating back returns to upload form
Uploading first.txt then navigating back and uploading second.txt shows correct names
Uploading three different files sequentially shows correct name each time
Uploading a file with spaces in the name preserves the exact filename
Uploading a file with parentheses preserves the exact filename
Uploading a file with hyphens preserves the exact filename
Uploading a file with underscores preserves the exact filename
Uploading a file with mixed case preserves the exact case
Uploading a file with multiple dots preserves all dots
Uploading a file with special characters and spaces preserves everything
After successful upload, browser back button retains file in input
Fresh navigation to /upload after successful upload resets the page completely
Double-clicking Upload button with file selected does not cause errors
File input does not accept multiple files (single file only enforced)
Success page does not have a form element
Clicking Upload multiple times with no file returns error each time
Refreshing the success page does NOT re-upload the file

defects.title: Form element has no action attribute — expected action ending with /upload
steps: Inspect the form element wrapping the file input.
defects.expected: Form element has action attribute matching /\/upload$/ (e.g. '/upload' or the full URL).
defects.actual: Form element's action attribute is empty (null/empty string); toHaveAttribute('action', /\/upload$/) times out after 10 seconds.

defects.title: Refreshing the success page does not return to the upload form
steps: Select a file and click Upload.
On the success page, reload the page (page.reload()).
defects.expected: After reload, the page shows the 'File Uploader' heading and empty file input (initial upload form state).
defects.actual: After reload, the 'File Uploader' heading is not found; toBeVisible() times out after 10 seconds — the page does not revert to the upload form.
